Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- Unnamed `generate` now checks freshness as it reaches each operation in program order, so operations made stale by an earlier generation in the same call are regenerated. Named generation keeps its old behaviour (`crates/app/src/script/api.rs`).
- The change is in the command path, shared by the GUI and MCP. No direct field write was added; the MCP description in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` now states the order and the refusal behaviour.
- The pinning test `unnamed_generate_rechecks_downstream_freshness_in_program_order` checks every operation after one call, the generated order, and the empty second call. The mutation notes in the body show it fails without the fix.
- `docs/decisions/2439-generate-current.md` records the choice. Body complete: `Changelog:`, `Fixes #2439` (the open issue with that exact symptom), conventional subject, no goldens moved.

## Results, merged with main

Built locally by this lane in a review worktree on Windows, trial-merged with current main; the merge commit was never pushed.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app` lib | 370 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored |
| `mcp_generate` | 18 passed, 0 failed |
| mcp / project round-trip / operations / tool_cycle / cli suites (mapped by the diff) | pass, 0 failed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean, exit 0 |

The author's own marker comment on this PR is not counted here; this is the independent review.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. Freshness during a named run still regenerates only the named operation (stated in the body). If a user later asks "why did my named generate leave the neighbour stale", the refusal text could name the stale operation. That is a P7 polish idea, not part of this fix.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 6d9bfcb6f5e17382f15dc5653016009ac16088ed -->

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What looks good**

- `v_generate` now checks each operation's status at the moment the loop reaches it, in program order (`inventory` uses `setup::operation_order`). This is the fix the issue asked for: one unnamed call leaves no operation stale.
- Each generation still rides its own `GenerateOperation` command through `env.history.execute`. A refusal propagates with `?` and names the operation; earlier generations stay real and undoable. No direct field writes. (AGENTS.md "Everything Is a Command".)
- The skip condition (`status_of(...) == OpStatus::Ok`) only skips operations that are current when reached. Never-generated operations are still generated. Nothing regenerates silently, and nothing stale is left behind.
- The MCP `generate` description now matches the behaviour, and the decision record explains what was dropped (batch loops, routing through `RegenerateAll`).
- The pinning test fails on main's `api.rs` and passes with the fix. The reviewer verified both on the merged tree.

**Results (built locally, trial merge with main `c0c92ee86`; merge is clean)**

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| build, `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | pass |
| `mcp_generate` (new) | 2 passed |
| `mcp` | 22 passed |
| `mcp_verify` | 3 passed |
| `scripting` | 19 passed |
| `commands_undo` | 30 passed |
| `generate_staged` | 2 passed |
| `verify` | 21 passed, 2 ignored |
| app lib, filters `script::` `mcp::` | 7 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | pass |

The new test was also run against main's pre-fix `api.rs`: the unnamed pin failed there, as the body claims.

**Requested before merge**

None.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- The issue asks whether the GUI's Generate All shares the loop. The body answers by inspection: it already uses rounds. This review did not run the GUI.
- `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` is now 434 lines. The file passed 400 before this PR; this change adds a net 2 lines. A future split is owed, not here.
- The reviewer's worktree was removed by another session's cleanup once, mid-review. All steps above ran again on a fresh trial merge after that.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
